liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls the Dew very good, though the show overall is more party-like than chilling; Brent and Jerry feed each other to a quick, emotional, unique peak [17][21][22]
- **Touch of Grey** (2 reviews): Reviewer found this opening version terrific, singing along to the 'I will get by' refrain; Above-average version, with Lesh's bass adding meat behind it [16][19]
- **Minglewood Blues** (1 review): A solid version, longer than average [19]
- **Friend of the Devil** (1 review): Reviewer singles out this as a nice version [24]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): Jerry could barely contain his laughter, and Hell in a Bucket was restarted [17]
- **Hell in a Bucket** (1 review): Bob got carried away during this song, so the band started it over [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **bucket false start**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **crowd, tuning, radio talk**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-04-07.fm.pasternak.andrewf.89971.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): FM broadcast; 24 songs; 151 min; rated 3.2/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd87-04-07.fmsbd.neo_levo.19284.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 157 min; rated 3.56/5 by 9 [3]. Said about its sound: Radio soundboard is somewhat tinny and hissy, though reviewer guesses it beats the audience recording; Recording makes the band sound more muscular and full-bodied, with Lesh's bass prominent [16][19]
- **gd1987-04-07.173263.mtx.tobin.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 151 min [6]
- **gd1987-04-07.173300.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: source not stated; 22 songs; 151 min [8]

## Around the show

- Listener recalls word in the parking lot after the show, calling it a classic Byrne show [14]
- Reviewer attended as a high school sophomore from the 15th row; Jerry wore red [18]
- Reviewer recalls Jersey run security paranoia and a rainbow over the parking lot during the run [20]
- Show has a north Jersey, New York electricity, described as a straightforward good-time show [24]
- Bob Weir's station ID is audible at the start of Throwing Stones [1]
- Band was energized by In the Dark and just beginning to rotate Touch of Grey heavily [18]
- Reviewer rates this one of the best shows of the run at the venue [20]
- Reviewer ranks 3-30-88 as the best Dew, with 2-24-74 and a 94 Nassau close behind [22]
- Reviewer found it disappointing compared with the Hartford and Worcester shows just before it [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-04-07.fm.pasternak.andrewf.89971.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Jon Pasternak; transferred by Andrew F.; source: WNEW-FM > unknown receiver > Onkyo TA-2048 > TDK SA-90's, with Dolby C on [1]. Also: FM recording patched from ShnID-19284 source, fixing a glitch and a tape flip in Space; Edited with Soundforge for fades, levels and patches; TLH used for SBE-OK, FLAC and checksums [1]
- **gd87-04-07.fmsbd.neo_levo.19284.sbeok.shnf**: source: FM-SBD(WNEW)>C>CDR>WAV>SHN. Transfer to CDR via jabuzz420. SHN encoding via neo_levo. [3]
- **gd1987-04-07.173263.mtx.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (48/16) [6]. Also: Mix made by an archive.org user, converted to FLAC in August 2025 with Trader Little Helper [6]
- **gd1987-04-07.173300.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound Mix (48k) [8]. Also: 5.1 mix made by an archive.org user, converted to FLAC in August 2025 with Trader Little Helper [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1987-04-06 Meadowlands Arena, East Rutherford, NJ, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-04-06-meadowlands-arena-east-rutherford-nj-usa/) [27]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Meadowlands Arena - April 7, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/april-7-1987) [29]
- Poster by www.amazon.fr: [Meadowlands Arena, East Rutherford, NJ, April 7th 1987: Grateful Dead: Amazon.fr: CD et Vinyles}](https://www.amazon.fr/Meadowlands-Arena-Rutherford-April-anglais/dp/B07NNM15CR) [30]
